hints.title: Right To Left Carry Propagation
hints.text: Adding one begins at the least significant digit. If that digit is less than nine, incrementing completes the operation without carry propagation.

hints.title: Nine Replacement Invariant
hints.text: Whenever a digit equals nine, adding one resets it to zero and propagates a carry of one into the preceding decimal position.

hints.title: Backward Increment Evaluation Procedure
hints.text: Traverse the digits array from right to left. If the current digit is strictly less than nine, increment it by one and return the array immediately. Otherwise set it to zero. If the loop completes without returning, prepend a one to the array and return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting the digit array to a numeric integer triggers overflow errors for arrays exceeding 64-bit limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place digit modification takes O(N) time and requires O(1) auxiliary space (O(N) only if prepending a new leading digit).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that early return happens on any digit strictly less than 9, handling [9, 9, 9] with prepend.
